svg.title: Painted poster background — editable vector study
svg.desc: Original reconstruction study using manually mapped colour areas and seeded geometric paint marks. The reference screenshot is not embedded, traced or sampled by this generator. All artwork consists of opaque filled paths; no raster images, SVG filters or live effects. The background hidden behind the original lettering and illustration is inferred. Approximate visual colours, not measured historic printing inks.
